method: Score = 3*programs + 2*quick + 1.5*builder + 1*missions + 0.5*camp + 0.5*warmup, every term read from the real code/data (modules imported and run, not guessed). programs = number of program DAYS (68 in all) that contain the move. Fixed plans (workoutLibrary PLAN_PROGRAMS: 16 plans, 57 days, each distinct move counted once per day, warm-up block included because it runs every day) are exact; the 4 Programs-screen splits (workoutPrograms PROGRAMS: 11 days, muscle chips -> generator) are the expected number of days the move is dealt, from 250 seeded runs of generateFitModeWorkout per day and gear (Weighted 50% / Bodyweight 25% / Hybrid 25%: the screen default counts half). quick = expected appearances in 100 generated Quick Missions: generateQuickMission run seeded over gear (Bodyweight 50 / Weighted 25 / Hybrid 25) x 5 focus tags x 4 levels x minutes 5,10,15,20,30,45,60 (420 combos x 24 runs, cardio finisher on in 1 run in 10), so pool membership, focus tags and the pool size are all in it. builder = expected appearances in 100 Workout Builder workouts (Programs excluded): generateFitModeWorkout over single muscle chips + the default CHEST+BACK + all chips, gear (Bodyweight 50 / Weighted 25 / Hybrid 25) x Easy/Normal/Hard, 30 min (120 runs per config), plus 0.5 for each membership of the two hand-curated cardio lists (the generator's 8-move finisher list and the shared CARDIO add-on menu). missions = number of v2 loadout missions (36 defs, authored base moves across beginner/standard/elite, swap alternatives not counted) + 7 other named workouts (Murph, Deadly Seven ...) + 10 library classics (53 mission sources) whose moves include it, once per mission. camp = number of open Arcade stages (One Hundred, Gravity Chamber, Martial Monster, Destroyer, Grappler: fit prescriptions and fight finishers; locked sagas excluded) + Combat Conditioning prebuilts and library entries + Rush explosive pool entries + concept-drop fit days that name it. Training Camp levels name no exercises (goal strings only). warmup = number of warm-up suggestion lists naming it (the 4 warm-up chips under the ring timer, the 6-move mobility block, the Combat Conditioning warm-up category); the 6-move warm-up block that opens 38 plan days is counted under programs because it runs inside those days. Names are matched to the library by normalised name (case, hyphens, plural, parentheticals ignored) plus a short hand alias list for obvious synonyms; compound names ("V-Ups and Flutter Kicks") credit each part that matches. QUICK pool names that are not library names are separate ids "quick:<kebab>" (with sameAs pointing at the nearest library move where one is obvious). Names that match neither are listed in usage-unmatched.json.
